fans.title: Your fans
fans.description: Add each fan with its own Bluetooth address and PIN. Find these in the official app. Each entry must identify one fan.

pin.title: Fan PIN
pin.description: Enter this fan’s six- or eight-digit PIN, including any leading zeroes. The PIN is stored in your Homebridge configuration.

maxManualRpm.title: Maximum requested speed for this fan (RPM)
maxManualRpm.description: Optional. Limits Boost, CO₂ Clear and speed-slider requests for this fan. Leave blank for a conservative 2400 RPM limit. Some fans return Pause when they reject a higher target. Only raise this limit to a speed verified to work on your fan. This does not change its permanent presets or measured-speed display.

showBoostSwitch.title: Show Boost Fan in Apple Home
showBoostSwitch.description: Start a timed boost. Turn Boost Fan off, or turn the main Fan on, to return to automatic ventilation.

boostRpm.title: Boost speed (RPM)
boostRpm.description: Choose a speed in steps of 25 RPM. The Home speed slider also starts a temporary session.

showPauseSwitch.title: Show Pause Fan in Apple Home
showPauseSwitch.description: Optional separate pause switch. The main Fan already pauses temporarily when turned off. Turn Fan on to return to automatic ventilation. Existing explicitly enabled Pause switches remain enabled.

pauseMinutes.title: Pause duration (minutes)
pauseMinutes.description: Turning the main Fan off starts this timed pause, even when Pause Fan is hidden. The fan resumes automatically when its own timer ends.

silentHoursStart.title: Quiet hours start
silentHoursStart.description: Optional. Use 24-hour time, such as 22:00. Set both times. A changed schedule is saved to the fan once; later app edits are respected.

silentHoursEnd.title: Quiet hours end
silentHoursEnd.description: Use 24-hour time, such as 06:00. Leave both fields blank to retain the fan’s existing schedule.

showSilentSwitch.title: Show Silent Hours in Apple Home
showSilentSwitch.description: Enable or disable the fan’s saved quiet-hours schedule. This preserves its times; it does not start an immediate pause.

co2ClearEnabled.title: Show CO₂ Clear in Apple Home
co2ClearEnabled.description: Extra ventilation when CO₂ rises. Set up two automations: CO₂ high → CO₂ Clear On; CO₂ acceptable → CO₂ Clear Off. For Netatmo, use Controller for HomeKit to create the all-clear rule. CO₂ Clear Off returns control to the fan’s own ventilation, including its humidity response. The switch starts Off and waits for an automation or your command.

co2ClearRpm.title: Speed for extra ventilation (RPM)
co2ClearRpm.description: 2400 RPM is 96% on the Home speed scale. Any lower limit you have chosen for an individual fan still applies.

co2ClearLeaseMinutes.title: Fan timer if Homebridge disconnects (minutes)
co2ClearLeaseMinutes.description: Normally leave this at 15 minutes. While CO₂ Clear is active, SvaraHome keeps this short fan timer topped up. If Homebridge stops, the timer expires and the fan returns to its own automatic ventilation. This is separate from the maximum running time above.

co2ClearMaxMinutes.title: Maximum time for extra ventilation (minutes)
co2ClearMaxMinutes.description: If the sensor’s all-clear never arrives, CO₂ Clear ends after this time and hands back to the fan’s own automatic ventilation. The default is one hour. Sending On again during a session does not extend it. After it ends or Homebridge restarts, a new On request is needed.

layout.title: CO₂ Clear — extra ventilation when CO₂ rises
